name: Moral Absolutes
overview: Scripture reveals that moral absolutes are grounded in the unchanging character and commandments of God, as Jesus declares Himself the exclusive way to the Father and calls for obedience to His commandments (John 14:6, 14:15). The Bible warns against confusing good and evil, emphasizing a clear distinction between them (Isaiah 5:20), and teaches that believers must not be conformed to worldly patterns but transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Additionally, loyalty to God alone is essential, as one cannot serve both God and worldly masters (Luke 16:13), and all authority is ultimately ordained by God (Romans 13:1).
